## Problem

When the daily release resumes an older pending version on a later day, the changelog committed at prepare no longer matches the generator after tagging. `changelog:check` on main then fails until someone regenerates.

Seen on pm-ops itself (2026-11-16): `v2026.11.15` was prepared and tagged on 11-16 (tag creator date `2026-11-16 17:43 UTC`). Prepare rendered `## 2026.11.15 - 2026-11-15`, because the version was still untagged and `--date-from-version` applied. Once the tag exists, pm-changelog uses the real tag date (by design, see unbraind/pm-changelog#120), and `npm run changelog:full` on unchanged main renders `## 2026.11.15 - 2026-11-16`. So `npm run changelog:check` fails on main with `Changelog is out of date: CHANGELOG.md`, and every pm-ops PR inherits the failure. Any caller whose release resumes past midnight hits the same drift.

## Proposal

When `decideDailyRelease` resumes a version whose date is before `today`, prepare should render the heading with the date the tag will carry: today in `RELEASE_TIMEZONE`, the same value the release step tags with. A contract test should prove that the changelog generated in prepare equals the one generated after tagging, for both a same-day and a resumed release.

## Acceptance

- After a resumed release, `changelog:check` passes on main with no follow-up regeneration.
- A same-day release is unchanged.

### GitHub comments (3)

> **@unbraind** (2026-11-19T19:59:26Z)
>
> For resumed releases, the changelog heading uses the verified merge commit's committer day. This supersedes the `RELEASE_TIMEZONE` heading wording in this issue and matches the date the tag generator reads from `%cI`. A fixture across Vienna midnight checks that the committed heading survives post-tag regeneration byte for byte. `RELEASE_TIMEZONE` still governs scheduling and the version coordinate. Implemented in #295 (a7584d2).

> **@unbraind** (2026-11-22T02:57:57Z)
>
> Confirmed downstream instance in PM Web (no separate mechanism inferred). Its `v2026.11.15` tag points at default `23958cda18b4fff5add8bd8b7b819bc72eb468cf`, committed Nov 20 at 14:07:44 UTC. Committed heading is `## 2026.11.15 - 2026-11-15`; tagged regeneration in the exact Node 26 quick release checks changes only the displayed heading date to `2026-11-20` and classifies the drift as `tracker_changed`. Verified in three unrelated workflow-pin PRs: [#351 closeout](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/actions/runs/44976604360/job/137067795269), [#352 daily release](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/actions/runs/44976613178/job/137067822001), and [#353 sync](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/actions/runs/44976619577/job/137067840142). This includes the caller-only Daily Release update, so updating a pin does not restore the already-tagged heading. Preserve the verified-committer-day contract in #295; for already-tagged affected callers, regenerate from the existing tag without retagging or weakening the check, then verify their next resumed release needs no post-tag repair. Main green full release-check is not inferred from its separate Daily Release workflow.

> **@unbraind** (2026-11-22T09:04:40Z)
>
> Additional downstream confirmation: [PM TS Starter #226](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/pull/226) at `79f9b00cba4cf50ab3992d2038eb5b560cdd95b9` changes only the `actions/download-artifact` pin in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Quick and coverage shards passed, but the [release-gate job](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/actions/runs/45004075327/job/137151701785) failed at `changelog:check`: the committed heading `2026.11.19 - 2026-11-19` regenerates as `2026.11.19 - 2026-11-20`. `v2026.11.19` points to [release commit `8e0c2e8`](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ts-starter/commit/8e0c2e8a249580ddb10f034d6e8da3d9470e56b7), committed November 20 at 15:02:56 UTC. This is a second downstream caller beyond PM Web, on a PR unrelated to the release or changelog pins. The log does not expose a separate drift classification. Please include this date-only case when verifying the resumed-release contract; for an existing tag, regenerate from the fixed tag date without moving it.
Resumed daily release commits a changelog heading the tagged release no longer generates (changelog:check red on main)
